zh.siteTagline: AI 诊疗 · 职业模拟
zh.heroTitle: 扮演医生，体验真实诊疗
zh.heroDesc: 模拟医生是一款 AI 驱动的医疗诊疗模拟游戏。基于 DeepSeek 生成无限病例，从实习医生晋升到主任医师，问诊、查体、检查、诊断、治疗全流程，挑战你的临床思维。
zh.downloadCta: 在 iOS App Store 中搜索「模拟医生」下载
zh.featuresSubtitle: AI 病例 · 职业进阶 · 真实诊疗流程
zh.featureCasesDesc: 基于 DeepSeek AI 大模型生成无限真实病例，每个病人都有独特的症状、病史和体征，病例难度随等级动态调整。
zh.featureCareerDesc: 从实习医生起步，通过准确诊断积累经验逐步晋升：住院医师（治愈100人）→ 主治医师（300人）→ 副主任医师（600人）→ 主任医师（1000人），每一步带来更高声望与更复杂病例。
zh.featureFlowDesc: 问诊了解主诉与病史、查体发现异常、选择辅助检查、疑难病例可申请会诊、体力不足可转诊，最后综合诊断并制定治疗方案治愈病人。
zh.featureResourceDesc: 平衡体力值、精神值、声望值与金钱；正确诊断获得经验与声望，错误会降低声望甚至面临吊销执照；合理策略成为顶尖医生。
zh.aboutDesc: 模拟医生为医疗职业模拟游戏，适合医学爱好者、医学生与喜欢模拟策略的玩家，在娱乐中了解诊疗流程与临床思维。
zh.disclaimerText: 本应用为模拟游戏，所有病例和诊断结果均由 AI 生成，仅供娱乐和学习使用，不能替代真实医疗诊断。如有健康问题，请咨询专业医生。

en.heroTitle: Play as a doctor, experience real diagnosis
en.heroDesc: Sim Doctor is an AI-driven medical diagnosis simulation game. DeepSeek generates unlimited cases; rise from intern to chief physician through consultation, exam, tests, diagnosis, and treatment.
en.downloadCta: Search "Sim Doctor" in the iOS App Store to download
en.featuresSubtitle: AI cases · Career progression · Real workflow
en.featureCasesDesc: DeepSeek AI generates unlimited realistic cases; each patient has unique symptoms, history, and signs; difficulty scales with your level.
en.featureCareerDesc: Start as an intern and advance by accurate diagnosis: Resident (cure 100) → Attending (300) → Associate Chief (600) → Chief (1000). Each step brings higher reputation and harder cases.
en.featureFlowDesc: Consultation, physical exam, lab and imaging, specialist referral when needed, referral when low on stamina—then diagnose and treat to cure patients.
en.featureResourceDesc: Balance stamina, mental health, reputation, and money. Correct diagnosis rewards exp and reputation; mistakes can cost your license. Manage wisely to become a top doctor.
en.aboutDesc: Sim Doctor is a medical career simulation game for medical enthusiasts, students, and strategy fans—learn diagnosis workflow and clinical thinking through play.
en.disclaimerText: This app is a simulation game. All cases and diagnoses are AI-generated for entertainment and learning only; they do not replace real medical care. Please consult a qualified doctor for health concerns.
